│     digits = ''.join(ch for ch in s if ch.isdigit())                                                                                                                                                               │

│             return st[:half+1] + st[:half][::-1]                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     # If num is palindrome, try next palindrome strictly greater than num                                                                                                                                          │
│     # Otherwise, get palindrome by mirroring left to right and compare                                                                                                                                             │
│     p = make_palindrome(s)                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     if int(p) > num:                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│         return int(p)                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     # Need to increment the middle part and then mirror again                                                                                                                                                      │
│     s_list = list(s)                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     mid = (length - 1) // 2                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     # Increment the middle digit(s)                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     if length % 2 == 1:                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│         # Odd length: increment middle digit and handle carry                                                                                                                                                      │
│         i = mid                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│         while i >= 0:                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│             if s_list != '9':                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                 s_list = str(int(s_list) + 1)                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                 break                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│             else:                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                 s_list = '0'                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                 i -= 1                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│         if i < 0:  # all digits were 9 after increment, handled above, so won't happen here                                                                                                                        │
│             pass                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     else:                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│         # Even length: increment the left middle digit and handle carry                                                                                                                                            │
│         i = mid                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│         while i >= 0:                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│             if s_list != '9':                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                 s_list = str(int(s_list) + 1)                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                 break                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│             else:                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                 s_list = '0'                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                 i -= 1                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│         if i < 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│             pass                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     # Mirror left to right again                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     left = s_list[: (length // 2)]                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     if length % 2 == 0:                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│         new_pal = left + left[::-1]                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     else:                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│         new_pal = s_list[: (length // 2) + 1] + left[::-1]                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     return int("".join(new_pal))                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│ ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│ def sort_sublists(lst):                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│     # Sorting each sublist ascending lexicographically while preserving relative order among strings                                                                                                               │
│     # that share the same prefix of any length.                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # This means: when comparing two strings, if one is a prefix of the other (or they share a prefix),                                                                                                            │
│     # these strings should keep their original relative order.                                                                                                                                                     │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # To achieve this, we define a custom comparison key that respects lex order,                                                                                                                                  │
│     # but uses stable sort behavior and a custom comparator via key:                                                                                                                                               │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Strategy:                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     # We use Python's stable sort and a key that returns a tuple:                                                                                                                                                  │
│     # (string itself, original index)                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # But the problem is that we need to preserve the relative order of strings that share any prefix.                                                                                                             │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # That means: if s1 and s2 share a prefix of any length >= 1, their relative order must be preserved.                                                                                                          │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # So we cannot just sort lexicographically by the string alone.                                                                                                                                                │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Instead, we can do:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     # - group strings by all possible prefixes? That's complicated.                                                                                                                                                │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Another way:                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│     # For each pair of strings, if they share any prefix, then their relative order is preserved.                                                                                                                  │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # So for sorting, the only allowed reorderings are between strings that share no prefix at all.                                                                                                                │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Because prefix can be of any length >=1, and applies to any prefix length, this means:                                                                                                                       │
│     # - If two strings share any prefix (even a single character), they must keep order.                                                                                                                           │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # So the only swaps allowed are between strings that share no prefix at all.                                                                                                                                   │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # This is a partial order, not a total order.                                                                                                                                                                  │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Since Python's sort only accepts a key (not cmp), we need to implement a key that respects this.                                                                                                             │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # One method is:                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     # Iteratively bubble or stable sort by lex order, but do not reorder pairs sharing any prefix.                                                                                                                 │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # But that is complicated.                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Alternate approach:                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│     # Build a graph of "must preserve order" edges between strings sharing prefix.                                                                                                                                 │
│     # Then do a topological sort that is as sorted lex order as possible but respects that constraint.                                                                                                             │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # But that is complex and maybe beyond scope.                                                                                                                                                                  │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Instead, since the sort must be ascending lexicographic and stable, and preserve relative order of strings sharing prefix,                                                                                   │
│     # the simplest way is:                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # - For each sublist, partition the list into groups of strings that share the same prefix with at least one other string.                                                                                     │
│     # - Within each group, keep original order.                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     # - Between groups, sort lexicographically by the minimal string in the group.                                                                                                                                 │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # But prefix can be any substring from length 1 to length of the shortest string in group.                                                                                                                     │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # So what is the grouping criterion?                                                                                                                                                                           │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Two strings belong to the same group if there exists a chain of strings where every adjacent pair shares a prefix.                                                                                           │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # So we want to cluster strings by connected components of "shares prefix" relation.                                                                                                                           │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Then sort these groups lex order by minimal string in group.                                                                                                                                                 │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Finally, concatenate groups in that order, preserving intra-group order.                                                                                                                                     │
│     #                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│     # Let's implement this approach.                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     def shares_prefix(s1, s2):                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│         # Returns True if s1 and s2 share a prefix of length >= 1                                                                                                                                                  │
│         min_len = min(len(s1), len(s2))                                                                                                                                                                            │
│         for i in range(min_len):                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│             if s1 != s2:                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                 return False                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│         return min_len > 0  # share prefix of length min_len >= 1                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     from collections import defaultdict, deque                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     def build_graph(strings):                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│         # Build graph where edges connect strings sharing prefix                                                                                                                                                   │
│         n = len(strings)                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│         graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]                                                                                                                                                                             │
│         for i in range(n):                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│             for j in range(i+1, n):                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                 if shares_prefix(strings, strings):                                                                                                                                                                │
│                     graph.append(j)                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                     graph.append(i)                                                                                                                                                                                │
│         return graph                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     def connected_components(graph):                                                                                                                                                                               │
│         n = len(graph)                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│         visited = [False]*n                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│         comps = []                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│         for i in range(n):                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│             if not visited:                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                 q = deque()                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                 comp = []                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                 visited = True                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                 while q:                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                     u = q.popleft()                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                     comp.append(u)                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                     for v in graph:                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                         if not visited:                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                             visited = True                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                             q.append(v)                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                 comps.append(comp)                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│         return comps                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     result = []                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     for sublist in lst:                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│         if not sublist:                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│             result.append([])                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│             continue                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│         graph = build_graph(sublist)                                                                                                                                                                               │
│         comps = connected_components(graph)                                                                                                                                                                        │
│         # For each component, collect strings in original order                                                                                                                                                    │

│ ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│ ### Step 6: What does "preserve the original relative order of equal-prefix strings" mean when all strings share prefix "d"?                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ - Since all strings share prefix 'd', their relative order must be the same as original.                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ - So, no reordering allowed, because the entire list is one big prefix group.                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ - That means the sorted list must be:                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│   `['dog', 'deer', 'deal', 'dig']`                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ ### Step 7: So:                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ - Sorting lexicographically ascending would give `['deal', 'deer', 'dig', 'dog']`.                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ - But preserving the relative order of strings sharing prefix 'd' (which is all strings) means **no change** in order.                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ - Hence, the original list is the correct output.                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ ### Step 8: Check the proposed answers:                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ - A: `[['dog', 'deer', 'deal', 'dig']]`  (original order)                                                                                                                                                          │
│ - B: `[['deal', 'deer', 'dig', 'dog']]`  (fully lex sorted)                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ Given the clarification, preserving relative order of all 'd'-prefix strings means the original order must be kept.                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ ### Conclusion:                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ **CORRECT: A**                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│                 counter += 1                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                 path.pop()                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     from collections import Counter                                                                                                                                                                                │
│     result = []                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     backtrack([], Counter(s))                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│     return result                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│ ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│ ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│ import math                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ def min_Jumps(d: float, length: float) -> int:                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     if d == 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│         return 0                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     if length == 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│         return float('inf')  # cannot move if length is zero and d != 0                                                                                                                                            │
│     if length == d:                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│         return 1                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     if length > d:                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│         # One jump covers length > d, but can't land exactly at (d,0) unless length == d.                                                                                                                          │
│         # But since moves can be in any direction, can we reach (d,0) in one move if length > d?                                                                                                                   │
│         # No, because the jump length is fixed and the endpoint is at distance d < length.                                                                                                                         │
│         # But can we reach it in 2 moves?                                                                                                                                                                          │
│         # If the jump length is greater than d, then two jumps of length length can reach (d,0)                                                                                                                    │
│         # by forming a triangle with sides length, length and base d.                                                                                                                                              │
│         # So minimum jumps = 2 in this case.                                                                                                                                                                       │
│         return 2                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     # If length < d,                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     # minimum jumps is ceiling of d/length                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     jumps = math.ceil(d / length)                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│     return jumps                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│     # Check if arr is already sorted (non-decreasing)                                                                                                                                                              │
│     if all(arr <= arr for i in range(n-1)):                                                                                                                                                                        │
│         return True                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     # Try all possible right shifts:                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     # A right shift by k means the array is rotated right by k positions.                                                                                                                                          │
│     # Instead of actually rotating, we can simulate or use slicing.                                                                                                                                                │
│     for k in range(1, n):                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│         rotated = arr[-k:] + arr[:-k]                                                                                                                                                                              │
│         if all(rotated <= rotated for i in range(n-1)):                                                                                                                                                            │
│             return True                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     return False                                                                                                                                                                                                   │

│         consonant_count = sum(1 for ch in word if ch.isalpha() and ch not in vowels)                                                                                                                               │
│         if consonant_count == n:                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│             result.append(word)                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│     return result                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│ ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│ def min_Jumps(d: float, length: float) -> int:                                                                                                                                                                     │
│     if d == 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│         return 0                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     if length == 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│         return float('inf')  # cannot move if length is zero and d != 0                                                                                                                                            │
│     if length == d:                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│         return 1                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     if length > d:                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│         # One jump covers length > d, but can't land exactly at (d,0) unless length == d.                                                                                                                          │
│         # But since moves can be in any direction, can we reach (d,0) in one move if length > d?                                                                                                                   │
│         # No, because the jump length is fixed and the endpoint is at distance d < length.                                                                                                                         │
│         # But can we reach it in 2 moves?                                                                                                                                                                          │
│         # If the jump length is greater than d, then two jumps of length length can reach (d,0)                                                                                                                    │
│         # by forming a triangle with sides length, length and base d.                                                                                                                                              │
│         # So minimum jumps = 2 in this case.                                                                                                                                                                       │
│         return 2                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     # If length < d,                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│     # minimum jumps is ceiling of d/length                                                                                                                                                                         │
│     jumps = math.ceil(d / length)                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│     return jumps                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
